packages.section: Part C §8 'P3-int', the four deferred feel questions 1 and 2 (the flash's size in first person, the haymaker's flash), each behind an 'FP feel' toggle defaulting to today, plus F-motion's warm-up request and the VFX under F-look's linear tonemapper
packages.note: You own game/fx/hit_flash.gdshader, the contact-flash code in game/actors/humanoid_rig.gd (flash_at's overlay and its uniforms only; the sim's CombatActor.flash_at and its point stay untouched), game/level/room_kit.gd (warm_up_art only), new tests/test_flash_fp.gd, the two new tunables in Look > FP feel, and docs/milestones/M4-calls/P3-flash.md. Steps: (1) Feel question 1 (grab-05: the hold's knee flash covered about 16% of the view three times a hold; hit-01: a flurry strobes 14-18% of the view at 8.6 Hz): add hit_flash_fp_max_share (0 = off, today's behaviour), a cap on the flash's ON-SCREEN radius computed in the shader from the camera distance, so a flash a few cm from the lens can't fill more than that share of the view. Measure the flash's white share of the view with the art Punk in first person, in the hold's knees and in a P P P P flurry, at the default (off) and at a suggested value, and print both. (2) Feel question 2 (r3look-05: the haymaker's flash barely shows in first person): add hit_flash_finisher_radius_mult (1.0 = today), applied to finishers only. Measure the haymaker's flash share at 1.0 and at a suggested value. (3) F-motion's request: RoomKit.warm_up_art also builds the Bruiser's and the boss's boxer named libraries (HumanoidRig._named_library at their rig scales), so their first spawn doesn't pay about 17 ms. Windowed only, like the rest of the warm-up. (4) The VFX under the linear tonemapper: record tests/bot/vfx_bot.tscn's tiers and a finisher with the impact frame on, compare them with M2's look (P1-fx's captures or a filmic run with --tune=look_tonemap=1), and report whether the unshaded sprites now read too bright or too saturated. Fix only through existing VFX tunables if they clearly do, and log it. Every toggle defaults to today. tests/test_flash_fp.gd covers both caps (headless, through the shader's math mirrored in GDScript like ToonMaterials.outline_width_m, or the uniforms set), the finisher-only rule, and that both defaults leave today's flash unchanged. Look at the recordings in first person and say honestly what each suggested value does to the feel.
